_comment: The reference is the web's unauthorizedWrites and sealingDekId as they were before the move into the core (web/static/js/app.js at REFERENCE), run in node over seeded random snapshots: folders and items under team folders, the organisation's tree, personal trees, folders the snapshot lacks, cycles; keys of the log, of an account and of a folder; write grants; tombstones and moves against a previous snapshot; with and without a team log. Every side (core, desktop, web, phone) must give the same answers; never regenerate this file to make a side pass. The header rule is the phone's (the strictest of the four that had drifted apart): an envelope header (alg 1, schema 1, 53 bytes), an ASCII id, an empty id names no key.
